commercialPurpose: Let editorial/CMS buyers show a premium long-form feed while keeping monetization, author trust, and discovery tools visible.
purposeLayer: The section turns a homepage into an editorial browsing system with persistent utility and proof context.
anatomyLayer: Large lead article, excerpt body, metadata, read-more/share row, right sidebar with author bio, newsletter, Instagram grid, tags, categories, ads, latest posts.
hierarchyLayer: Lead article first, sidebar trust/discovery second, repeated feed modules third.
gridRhythmLayer: Two-column content/sidebar frame with a wider editorial column and narrow stacked utility rail.
densityLimitLayer: Use one lead post, 3-8 sidebar widgets grouped by role, and repeated article modules with clear rhythm.
originalityLayer: Learn content plus persistent utility rail; adapt widgets to product-specific proof rather than copying blog widget order.
usageRuleLayer: Use for blogs, magazines, resource hubs, thought-leadership sites, case-study centers, and education content hubs.
layoutGesture: lead editorial post with persistent discovery sidebar
sectionSilhouette: wide content column paired with narrow stacked widget rail
compositionTension: long reading flow balanced by compact commercial and trust widgets
focalPath: lead image to article title to excerpt to sidebar author/newsletter widgets
negativeSpaceShape: vertical reading lane separated from tight sidebar stacks
depthLayering: flat content plane with boxed sidebar modules and image/ad cards
moduleScaleVariation: large post media contrasted with small stacked widgets
breakoutBehavior: sidebar persists while content modules change media format
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact right-sidebar widget sequence, image thumbnails, author portrait, ad creative, or gold accents.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint learning is visually inspected but not yet promoted to stable PASS; keep as incoming review vocabulary.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the Pallas-style script logo, muted gold CTA treatment, right-sidebar widget order, image set, or exact editorial spacing.
